fact: The ICT Minister said the national ID system has over 13.5 million people registered, about 99 percent of citizens aged 16 and above; against the population of 22.2 million held (2025) that is about 61 percent of all ages.

Malawi's national identity system holds information on more than 13.5 million registered people, per current reporting cited by the column; against 22.2 million population that is about 61% (share computed from the held population).

More than 13.5 million people are registered in the national ID system, which the ICT minister put at about 99 percent of citizens aged 16 and above; against the 22.2 million population held this is about 61 percent of the whole population (computed).
